greenIsinsNote: The on-issue table has no green flag. Green lines = this list plus any ISIN whose issuance row has a "Green Bond/" tender-number prefix (the June 2036 syndication TBSYN37 lacks that prefix, hence the list). Add new green lines here.
dataHubDiscovery: Each run scrapes /data-hub and matches link text: "treasury bonds - issuance.xlsx", "Treasury Indexed Bonds - Issuance[_N].xlsx", "Treasury Notes - Issuance.xlsx", "portfolio_aggregate_-_dealt[_N].xlsx", "treasury_indexed_bonds_-_indexation_factors[_N].xlsx", "foreign_holdings[_N].xlsx". Each must match exactly once or the run fails. Dated paths below are research-time observations only.

access.cdn: Akamai edge (2.22.249.x). Requests lacking browser-like Accept, Accept-Language and Accept-Encoding headers are tarpitted (connection hangs, curl exit 28/92, no HTTP status). A research User-Agent is accepted when those three headers are present.
access.fileUrlStability: Data Hub files live at /sites/default/files/<upload-date>/<name>.xlsx. Files are overwritten in place (the 2025-06-20 path held data to 2026-10-09), but a re-upload can change the date folder (e.g. Retail Register Buybacks moved to 2026-09-22). Discover current hrefs by scraping /data-hub on each run; /media/<id> aliases 302-redirect to the current file where an id is known.
access.userAgentNote: Verified 2026-10-12: the default pipeline User-Agent (contains a URL) and a bare Chrome UA without sec-ch headers are both tarpitted; "uk-fiscal-research/0.1 (research tool)" with the three Accept headers returns 200. The adapter overrides the User-Agent per request.

stock.name: AOFM Portfolio Aggregate - Treasury Bonds (dealt basis), FaceValue sheet
stock.format: xlsx, wide: header rows 2-6 (Liability/Asset, Currency, Instrument, Maturity, Coupon %), then one row per month-end, one column per line, plus a 'Total AUD Treasury Bonds' column. Sheets: Notes, FaceValue, MarketValue, Delta, Duration, Tenor.
stock.units: AUD, full units (not millions); liabilities shown negative; coupon percent per year
stock.basis: End-of-month face value outstanding by line, dealt basis (transactions counted on trade date). A settlement-basis twin exists. No ISIN column, so join to ISINs on (maturity, coupon) using the securities pages or the issuance file.
stock.missingValues: Blank or empty string where a line is not on issue
stock.revisionBehaviour: File overwritten in place; archive each download

companions.note: TIB face value is unindexed (capital not uplifted); indexation factors are in a separate file (/media/1263)
All AGS liabilities plus assets and swaps

stock.note: Superseded as the stock source by the weekly on-issue tables (which carry ISINs); the all-instrument portfolio_aggregate_-_dealt file is used for stockHistory and the reconciliation.

weeklyStock.note: 29 lines including Green Treasury Bonds June 2034 (AU3TB0000200) and June 2036 (AU3TB0000291). HTML only, no download, and no flag column marking a line as green.

transactions.name: Treasury Bonds - Issuance (tender and syndication)
transactions.format: xlsx, sheet 'Transactions': row 1 title, row 2 headers, row 3 units, data from row 4; 'Notes' sheet
fields: Number of Bids Accepted in Full
transactions.quirks: ISINs padded with trailing spaces. Tender Number prefixes are TB, TBSYN (syndication), 'Green Bond/TB' and 'Green Bond/TBSYN'. Syndication rows hold empty strings for offered, bids and cover. Amounts are full AUD. Offered and allotted can differ because of RBA take-up. Secondary Market Mid Rate comes from Yieldbroker.

transactions.note: Same 20 columns. Yields are real yields. Prefixes TIB and TIBSYN; older INDEXTENDER and INDEXTAP
18 columns (no coupon and no secondary mid). Tender Number format NN/YY

transactions.format: xlsx, transposed (one column per deal); sheets 'New Bond Syndications' and 'Tap Syndications '

availability.stock: available: weekly on-issue tables with ISINs for Treasury Bonds, Treasury Indexed Bonds and Treasury Notes
availability.uplifted: derived: TIB indexed capital value = face value x Kt/100 using the AOFM Kt factor for the next coupon date
availability.auctions: available: every AOFM tender and syndication for the last five years in auctions; full history (TB from 1982, TIB from 1985, TN from 1989) in auctionHistory
availability.postAuction: not applicable: the AOFM has no post-auction option facility
availability.calendar: partial: AOFM announces the following week only (Friday midday Canberra time); earlier weeks are overwritten at source. Syndication windows in the issuance program are kept as text in issuanceProgram, not as dated operations
availability.ownership: available: quarterly non-resident share of AGS (market value) in foreignHoldings

definitions.stock: Australian Government Securities (Treasury Bonds incl. Green Treasury Bonds, Treasury Indexed Bonds and Treasury Notes) on issue, AUD million face value. Includes holdings by the RBA. Not general government gross or net debt, and not market value.
definitions.type: type follows the UK schema: conventional (nominal Treasury Bonds and Treasury Notes) or index-linked (Treasury Indexed Bonds). instrument gives the AOFM instrument name; green marks Green Treasury Bonds.
definitions.coupon: Annual coupon percentage of face value. Treasury Notes are discount securities and carry couponPct 0.
definitions.maturity: Contractual maturity of face value. TIB redemption depends on CPI through the indexation factor; no future indexation is forecast.
definitions.uplifted: Nominal lines: equal to face value. TIBs: DERIVED face value x Kt/100, where Kt is the AOFM capital indexation factor applying at the next coupon date after asOf. Not market value.
definitions.auctionAmounts: AUD million (AOFM publishes full dollars). Offered is the amount offered to the public; allotted can differ (e.g. RBA take-up). Syndications have no offered amount, bids or cover.
definitions.auctionYield: Weighted average issue yield: nominal for Treasury Bonds and Notes, real for Treasury Indexed Bonds; syndication rows carry the syndication pricing yield. Multiple-price tenders.
definitions.cover: AOFM coverage ratio = bids / amount offered.
definitions.tail: DERIVED: highest accepted yield minus weighted average issue yield, in basis points. Not published by the AOFM as a tail.
definitions.secondaryMid: AOFM-published secondary market mid rate at the time of the tender (Yieldbroker).
definitions.calendar: Forthcoming Transactions snapshot: announced tenders with size and ISIN; a TIB line may be given only as a date (status planned, size null).
definitions.foreignHoldings: Share of AGS on issue held by non-residents, market value basis, quarterly (ABS/RBA/APRA/AOFM compilation); repo-adjusted share also given. Past periods are revised.
definitions.stockHistory: Month-end face value (dealt basis) of AUD Treasury Bonds, TIBs (capital unindexed) and Treasury Notes from the AOFM Portfolio Aggregate; liabilities sign-flipped to positive.

notes: All money values are AUD million unless a field name says otherwise.
asOf is the date of the weekly AOFM on-issue tables; if the three instrument tables carry different dates, asOf is the earliest and totalsByInstrument gives each date.
Treasury Notes are included in the stock (they are AGS) but are short-term cash-management securities.
TIB upliftedMillion and auction tailBp are derived by this dashboard, not AOFM-published figures.

stockReconciliation compares the weekly on-issue total with the latest month-end Portfolio Aggregate plus allotments dealt since month end. A non-zero residual can reflect maturities, buybacks or settlement timing; it is informational and does not block publication.

auctions covers five years; auctionHistory is the full record in compact column form (instrumentCodes maps TB/TIB/TN). Rows with method other (historical taps, panels, conversions) appear only in auctionHistory.
The calendar is a single weekly snapshot; tenders already held appear in auctions, not in the calendar.
issuanceProgram.headline amounts are planned gross issuance as worded in the latest Budget or MYEFO notice; null where the wording was not recognised.
